content.text: T054: build the repository-transcript row adapter in evaluation/repo/, running through the shared pipeline.
Settled: the loading lives in evaluation/repo/dataset.py, where load_units returns one IngestUnit per transcript.
Questions sharing a transcript ingest it once, with group_id set to the transcript's stem, because ingesting per question would make the row's cost scale with the gold set instead of the corpus.
An unrecognised record shape is skipped rather than raised on: a transcript is an append-only log written by a versioned harness, so an unknown record must cost one message, never the row.
tests/evaluation/test_repo_row.py covers load_units and RepoAdapter end to end.
